description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different configurations of the Whisper model, a machine learning system for speech recognition, over a series of epochs during training. The x-axis, labeled "epoch," is linear and ranges from 0 to 6, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis, labeled "WER," which stands for Word Error Rate, is also linear and ranges from 30 to 70, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different configuration of the Whisper model: tiny AdaLoRA_int4, tiny AdaLoRA_int8, tiny int4, tiny int8, and tiny full. The tiny AdaLoRA_int4 line is solid with diamond markers, the tiny AdaLoRA_int8 line is dashed with square markers, the tiny int4 line is dash-dot with circle markers, the tiny int8 line is dotted with triangle markers, and the tiny full line is a solid line with no markers. The lines show a general trend of decreasing WER as the number of epochs increases, indicating an improvement in the model's performance over time. The tiny full line starts at the highest WER and ends at the lowest, suggesting it is the most effective configuration among those tested. The other lines show varying degrees of improvement, with the tiny AdaLoRA_int4 and tiny AdaLoRA_int8 lines showing the most significant decrease in WER.
